About Me

Finance meets the future of technology

I'm a banking and finance graduate from the University of Kotli, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, with a strong academic record and a passion for applying financial expertise to real-world problems — from school budgets to legislative policy research.

As a Prime Minister Ehsaas Scholarship recipient, I've pursued every opportunity to grow — interning at the National Assembly Secretariat, participating in Bank of America's investment banking simulation, and earning recognition in international essay competitions.

My unique edge: I actively bridge traditional finance with AI tools, automation, and digital workflows — hosting an AI podcast and building practical systems for financial operations optimization.
